qa_pairs.question: When using an OnDemand desktop session for STAR-CCM+, how do researchers run versions between 15.04.010 and 17.06.008 in serial mode?
qa_pairs.answer: To run STAR-CCM+ versions from 15.04.010 to 17.06.008 in serial mode within an OnDemand desktop, first load the `StdEnv/2020` module (which is now retired). Following that, load either `starccm-mixed/17.06.008` or `starccm/17.06.008-R8`, and then execute the command `starccm+`.

qa_pairs.question: What are the necessary steps to launch STAR-CCM+ versions from 15.04.010 to 17.06.008 in parallel on a local host within an OnDemand desktop environment?
qa_pairs.answer: To launch STAR-CCM+ versions from 15.04.010 to 17.06.008 in parallel on a local host within an OnDemand desktop, first load the `StdEnv/2020` module (which is retired). Subsequently, load either `starccm-mixed/17.06.008` or `starccm/17.06.008-R8`, and then use the command `starccm+ -np 2`.
